summary: Verified end-to-end on preview URL: (1) Age gate appears on fresh session, 'No' shows denial message, 'Yes' dismisses and sets localStorage ccc_age_ok=true (persists after reload). (2) Countdown modal appears after gate verification, timer ticks live, waitlist form submits and shows success, dismiss button hides modal and sets sessionStorage ccc_countdown_seen=true (does not reappear on reload). (3) Homepage renders all sections after scroll (hero 'The Cure.', featured grid, get-directions button, 3 journal cards) with no stuck opacity:0 elements, no webpack overlay, no console errors. Only benign framer-motion warnings about scroll container positioning.

issues: Console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' Repeats several times. Non-blocking but should be fixed by adding position:relative to the scroll target container used by useScroll.

action_items: Optional: fix framer-motion useScroll warning by ensuring the scroll target container has position:relative/absolute/fixed.

The originally reported 'age check does not seem to be working' bug is NOT reproducible on the preview URL — the age gate flow works correctly end-to-end. Likely was a stale production build; user should redeploy production.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 16 frontend checks passed: age-gate visible on fresh load, denial flow, Yes flow + localStorage persistence + no-reappear-on-reload, countdown modal + ticking timer + waitlist success + dismiss + sessionStorage + no-reappear-on-reload, homepage sections render (hero, featured grid, directions btn, 3 journal cards), no stuck invisible elements, no webpack overlay. Screenshots saved in /app/test_reports/. Only a benign framer-motion useScroll positioning warning in console.
rca of the issue: User-reported 'age check does not seem to be working' could not be reproduced in preview. On a fully cleared storage state, the age gate correctly renders, both Yes/No buttons behave correctly, localStorage 'ccc_age_ok' is properly set to 'true' on accept, and the gate does not reappear on subsequent reloads. Most likely RCA: the user was viewing a stale production deployment that predated the age-gate fix — a fresh redeploy to production should resolve the report.
